title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Chemical Disposal
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: A student has 50 mL of unused 10% Hydrochloric Acid (HCl). How should this be disposed of?
options: Pour it down the sink with plenty of water.
Pour it into a designated acidic chemical waste container.
Mix it with a base to neutralize it, then pour it into the trash.
Return it to the original stock bottle.
questions.explain: Chemical waste should never be poured down the sink unless explicitly permitted by local regulations (which is rare for strong acids). It should be placed in a properly labeled chemical waste container. Returning chemicals to stock bottles causes contamination.
